Adds the optional context telemetry section and context breakdowns to usage events. The file viewer can read host-wide paths and symlinks through the sandbox’s protected-path and regular-file checks. Includes framework tool-argument repairs, background-command capacity fixes and retained compaction counts. Protocol 95, configuration 29, Bot state 9 and checkpoint 20 are unchanged; no conversion is needed from 0.16.38.

Home-relative file paths resolve on the gateway host. Workspace ownership, numeric conversions and error handling now pass the expanded lint gates.
